name: 文心快码
solves: Writing code, you keep retyping the same boilerplate and hunting for APIs you cannot find. Completion follows what you are writing, and it turns a Figma file into a page.
solves_zh: 写代码时手边总有重复的模板和查不到的 API。补全能接着你写，还能把 Figma 稿转成页面。
best_for: You code day to day on a mainland network and want a completion assistant that works without a VPN.
best_for_zh: 在国内网络环境下做日常编码，需要一个不用翻墙的补全助手。
notes: 服务超千万开发者的国产编程助手代表，Figma 转代码是少数工具具备的能力 来源：https://comate.baidu.com/zh/page/x9rcbn4gmz2
